boundary: Original curated summaries and references only. No upstream skills, UI kits, fonts, scripts or dependencies are installed/vendored. Sources never grant authority or QA PASS.
gap_policy: Current live docs and target truth outrank cached recommendations. Unknown compatibility/license stays UNKNOWN. Re-review code at immutable refs and documentation before adopting unstable APIs.
